# Synthetic test data notice

Every fixture in this directory is fictional and exists only to test the Spend Management Analysis plugin. Names, identifiers, firms, clients, matters, timekeepers, invoices, rates, hours, budgets, and narratives do not describe real people or organizations. Similarity to real data is coincidental.

The matching golden outputs under `tests/expected/` must preserve this synthetic-data disclosure in every report and workbook summary.
